description: Look up the dbSNP rsIDs that a SPDI allele maps to, via NCBI Variation Services. AUTHORITATIVE for the reverse direction — you have a genomic coordinate and alleles from a VCF or a pipeline and need the rsID other databases key on. SPDI is 0-BASED, unlike HGVS: "NC_000007.14:140753335:A:T" is the same variant as "NC_000007.14:g.140753336A>T".
name: variation_spdi_to_rsids
